# Binding Wire Machine — Industrial Catalog

> Manufacturer and global exporter of high-speed automatic wire nail making machines, continuous wire drawing lines, and binding wire machinery in Rajkot, Gujarat, India.

## Primary Products
- IN Series Automatic Wire Nail Making Machines (IN1+, IN3, IN4, IN6)
- Continuous Wire Drawing Machine Plants (3 to 7 Blocks)
- Automatic Binding Wire Annealing and Coiling Setups
